name: Comacchio (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Comacchio (a fish on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Comacchio, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Comacchio arms — fish on blue, crowned, within branches
